title: Senior Business Analyst - Temenos T24 Securities
description:
Job Summary 
 Within the Wealth Management IT Hub Ops Division, the Senior Business Analyst (SBA) will lead the business analysis activities related to their area of expertise (Temenos Transact T24), covering the scope of International Wealth Management activity in Europe and in Asia. The Security Trading, Asset Transfers and Funds Business Analyst is responsible for gathering, analysing, documenting business requirements for Security Trading/Asset Transfers/Funds Management functionality across: Securities Trading (equities, bonds, funds, structured products); Positions Management; Instrument & Product Setup designing and supporting the implementation of Derivatives and Structured Products functionality within the Temenos Transact (T24) core banking system. 

 Responsibilities 
 The main missions of the SBA will be to: Acts as a key conduit between Front Office, Operations, Finance, Compliance and Tax, focusing on STP, process efficiency and recommendation of industry practices. Experienced in driving PLWs and able to advise new processes for new Transact applications, preferably with implementation experience. Gathers and documents Transact-focused requirements and translate operational/business needs into functional specifications. Experience in writing a BRD/FSD is a MUST. Analyses gaps in functionality and processes across European and Asian sites and proposing solutions to converge and align them into a common design, respecting WMIS standards and allowing for mutualization / reuse as much as possible between sites. Ensures all requirements are approached from a global perspective for all sites. Specific solution should only be considered to address regulatory, tax or accounting specific requirements. Provides SME support for Security Trading/Asset Transfers/Funds Management (in line with market standards and regulatory requirements). Trade Capture from Front Office and booking of equities, bonds, funds and structured products. Support configuration of Securities Instruments (ISIN, CFI, market attributes), trading products and deal types, market conventions (settlement cycles, holidays, cut-offs). Ensure accurate handling of Trade Date vs. Settlement Date, Buy/Sell indicators, Price, Yield and Nominal calculations. Trade Validation & Enrichment: Define validation rules for Instrument Eligibility, Account and Portfolio Checks, Trading limits and Restrictions. Support enrichment of trades with broker details, settlement instructions and fees and charges. Positions & Holdings Management Ensure real-time and end-of-day updates to Securities Positions and Holding Balances. Validate correct handling of Long/Short Positions and Blocked and Pending Quantities. Support reconciliation between trading, accounting and custody positions Settlement & Post-Trade Processing - Analyse settlement workflows for DVP/FOP Trades and Internal vs. External Settlements. Support configuration of Settlement Instructions (SSI) and Counterparty and Custodian Setup. Ensure accurate processing of Cash Movements and Accruals, Fees and Taxes. Support SWIFT Messaging (MT54X). FX & Cash Handling - Define requirements for FX Deal Generation from Securities Trades and Multi-currency settlement handling. Ensure correct postings of cash legs and FX Revaluation. Funds Grouping - Support the configuration for Transact Funds Grouping (Grouping Criteria, Cut-off time, communications to external TAs via MX messages). Funds Settlement - Receipt of NAV and settlement processing steps. Asset Transfers - Support the configuration for Transact Security.Transfer application for the management of internal, incoming and outgoing transfers (either DVP or FOP capabilities). Asset settlement - ensure correct posting of securities positions and cash management (where applicable). Fees, Charges & Taxes - Define and support the configuration of Brokerage Fees, Market Charges and Withholding Tax rules. Validate correct calculation and posting at Trade Booking and Settlement. Support Tax Reporting and Audit Requirements. Static Data & Reference Data - Support maintenance of Instruments and Markets, Brokers/Custodians and depositaries, and Standing Settlement Instructions (SSIs). Ensure data consistency across trading, settlement and accounting modules. Support interfaces with Order Management and execution platforms, Custodians and Clearing Systems. Collaborate with our Vendor (Temenos) and/or Integrator for the implementation project, and enable our internal team to acquire knowledge and deep expertise on Temenos Transact product. Contribute with/without our Integrator to the definition of use cases for Integration tests with testing team and for User Acceptance Test with end users. The SBA will be the privileged contact for user representatives during the analysis and project phases, and will be responsible for all standard business analysis tasks such as: Preliminary studies and analysis (including leading user workshops). Cost estimation and planning elaboration and follow-up. Organize and run dedicated meetings or committees, as required. Identify and report on project risks, attention points and issues to follow-up. Requirements and general functional specifications (GFS): Coordination of workshops, minutes, writing GFS, Review and validation with Sponsors, Presentation and support to Dev Team, etc. Coordinate with all teams, from same division or other divisions, working on the same project. Plan the migration strategy and change management activities related to these new projects. Coordinate, supervise and contribute to Users Acceptance Tests (UAT) related to new implementations and support user sign-offs. Ensure the good relationship with business sponsors and stakeholders on each location. Support production deployment activities, data migration and user training. Scope of project(s): TEMENOS T24/TRANSACT Core Banking Platform, focused on assigned area of expertise. Transversal topics involving other domains, with an impact on assigned area of expertise. 

 Skills 

 Must have 
 At least 7 years of experience in the banking industry, as a business analyst and/or as a hands-on project manager Expert knowledge and experience on Temenos Transact T24 Core Banking platform for Wealth Management, understand the various flows and functions, familiar with system parameterization and configuration, specifically in the area of Temenos Transact Security Trading/Funds Management/Fees modules (including withholding taxes, fees setup, accounting and regulatory reporting impacts, etc) - Mandatory Proficiency in User Acceptance Testing (UAT), functional & system integration testing of banking and financial applications Fluent in investigation and testing techniques (data analysis, SQL, API, etc)

 We are currently seeking an Engineering Delivery Manager to join the Decommissioning market within our Nuclear EMEA business. Our market provides our clients with sustainable engineered solutions to plant life extension, waste retrieval as well as dismantling and demolition problems across the full project life cycle including commissioning and operation. We can offer our own products and technology to provide innovative solutions that accelerate the pace of change and provide resource augmentation to support our clients and partners. 
 We have strong capabilities in the holistic design, assessment and substantiation of assets including chemical processes, process equipment and control systems, piping and pressure vessels, safety instrumented systems, mechanical handling equipment, structures, low voltage electrical power systems and building services. We tackle projects that have varied technical challenges and significant nuclear and conventional safety hazards. Our projects require proactive and collaborative working to brilliantly engineer a cleaner, safer, net zero world. 
 We continually invest in our people, technology, working facilities and supporting resources to ensure that we strengthen and grow our current capabilities as well as develop new capabilities. This allows us to deliver projects using industry leading and innovative techniques, such as utilising our growing technology solutions and robotics capabilities and showing that our solutions work through active demonstrators. 
 

 Your role 
 
 You will be accountable to the Engineering Delivery Lead for the engineering design, assessment and substantiation of technical complex nuclear decommissioning and waste management projects within a portfolio. 
 You will act as the Technical Governance Manager for the portfolio, and as such you will oversee the identification, management, and communication of technical risks throughout each project's life cycle, including bid phase. You will collate and manage portfolio technical risk and escalate to the Engineering Director where appropriate. 
 You will ensure consistent application of our Nuclear EMEA technical governance frameworks. 
 You will monitor the delivery of Engineering project activities and deliverables against cost and schedule and coach Project Engineering Managers to implement corrective action to achieve project milestones. 
 You will support Project Managers in defining Engineering resource requirements and mobilisation plans, and lead Engineering mobilisation activities for new projects and opportunities within the assigned portfolio. Working with Engineering Capability and delivery teams, you will identify resource constraints, recommend interventions where delivery performance is at risk, and escalate significant resource and mobilisation risks to the Engineering Delivery Lead. 
 You will support and coach Project Engineering Managers to strive for delivery excellence and identify and mentor future technical leaders in collaboration with their Capability Lead. 
 You will act as Project Engineering Manager or Technical Lead for the delivery of engineering design, assessment and substantiation of assets within technical complex nuclear decommissioning and waste management projects. 
 
 

 About you 
 
 The ideal candidate will possess a solid background in technical leadership, ensuring that our Project Engineering Managers have visible guidance. 
 You will have a comprehensive grasp of engineering in nuclear decommissioning encompassing plant life extension, waste retrieval as well as dismantlement and demolition. 
 You will be a proponent of our systems-based approach and rigorous in the application of our technical governance frameworks to ensure we deliver to the highest standards. 
 You will have a proficient understanding of risk assessment and management techniques to identify, mitigate, and communicate technical risks throughout the project lifecycle. 
 You will have leadership skills to guide and mentor project engineering managers, ensuring alignment with business objectives. 
 Problem-solving skills to address complex technical complexities and find effective solutions. 
 Communication skills to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate with various stakeholders. Proficiency in quality assurance processes to ensure the technical integrity and reliability of project deliverables. 
 You will demonstrate integrity and ethical behaviour in all professional interactions and decisions. Collaborate with stakeholders to align technology initiatives with business goals. Be adaptable and open to change within evolving environments. Foster a culture of innovation, promoting creativity and new ideas. Commit to continuous learning and professional development to keep up with changing technology. 
 
 

 How will you contribute to the team 
 
 An innovator - You will encourage people to experiment, produce new ideas and challenge others to think differently. You'll create space for people to think about potential new innovative approaches, providing an opportunity for growth. 
 An Improver - You spend time on making the processes, methods, and toolsets more efficient, optimising your resources to be able to deliver better. 
 A Visible Leader - You striving to produce work of the highest standard and quality will inspire colleagues. 
 Fully integrated with counterparts in other parts of the business and active in identifying cross-application of skills, best practice and learning material. 
 Excellent team player, able to collaborate effectively with market colleagues, wider business colleagues and the senior leadership team.

Job Title-SAP S/4HANA Project Manager - Greenfield Implementation - 14144 
 Shift: 2:00PM- 11:00PM Locations: Pune, Bangalore, Chennai, Noida, Hyderabad 

 Position Overview 
 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced SAP S/4HANA Project Manager with expertise in Greenfield implementation and transformation from SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA using the SAP Activate Methodology . The Project Manager will play a pivotal role in overseeing all phases of the migration project, from planning and execution to delivery, ensuring a seamless transition with minimal disruption to business operations. 

 Key Responsibilities 

 1. Project Planning and Strategy 
 Develop and implement a comprehensive project plan for the migration from SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA using Greenfield implementation . Define project scope, objectives, timelines, and resource requirements in alignment with business goals and objectives. Establish project governance structure, roles/responsibilities, and communication protocols to ensure effective project management. 

 2. Team Leadership and Management 
 Lead and manage cross-functional project teams, including SAP consultants, technical experts, and business stakeholders. Provide clear direction, guidance, and support to team members to ensure alignment with project goals and objectives. Foster a collaborative and inclusive team culture, promoting open communication and knowledge sharing. 

 3. Greenfield Data Loads 
 Oversee all aspects of the migration process, including data extraction, transformation, and loading using DS/ETL . Collaborate with technical teams to ensure data integrity, accuracy, and consistency throughout the migration process. Monitor progress, identify risks, and implement mitigation strategies to minimize downtime and disruptions during migration. 

 4. Stakeholder Engagement and Communication 
 Act as the primary point of contact for key stakeholders, including business leaders, IT management, and project sponsors. Provide regular updates, progress reports, and presentations to stakeholders on project status, milestones, and risks. Proactively address stakeholder concerns and expectations, ensuring alignment and buy-in throughout the migration process. 

 5. Quality Assurance and Risk Management 
 Implement quality assurance processes and controls to ensure the successful delivery of the migration project within scope, budget, and timeline constraints. Identify potential risks, issues, and dependencies early in the project lifecycle and develop proactive mitigation strategies. Conduct regular reviews and audits of project activities to monitor progress and address any deviations from the project plan. 

 6. Change Management and Training 
 Develop and execute change management strategies to facilitate user adoption of SAP S/4HANA and minimize resistance to change. Plan and coordinate training programs and knowledge transfer sessions to educate end-users on the new system and processes. Provide ongoing support and assistance to end-users during the transition period to ensure a smooth migration experience. 

 Qualifications 

 Education Experience 
 Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field . Master's degree preferred. 12+ years of experience in project management , with a focus on: SAP S/4HANA Greenfield implementations Brownfield implementations Selective Data Transfer/Bluefield implementations SAP migrations Proven experience leading SAP S/4HANA migration projects , particularly using Greenfield implementation. Experience leading onshore and offshore SAP functional and technical teams . Strong understanding of SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA modules, architecture, and migration tools . 

 Certifications

Experience with change management, stakeholder engagement, and risk management methodologies . Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to anticipate challenges and develop proactive solutions. Positive attitude and proactive nature to work with cross-teams. title: ASSISTANT MANAGER

Job Purpose To manage and streamline HR operations across corporate office and project sites, ensuring effective manpower management, employee lifecycle administration, statutory compliance, HR policy implementation, employee engagement, and coordination with project leadership to support business objectives. Key Responsibilities HR Operations Employee Lifecycle Management Manage end-to-end HR operations, including onboarding, joining formalities, induction, employee documentation, transfers, and exit formalities. Maintain and update employee master data, personnel files, HRIS, and organizational charts. Ensure timely issuance of appointment letters, confirmation letters, transfer letters, and other HR-related documents. Monitor employee attendance, leave management, regularization, and employee movement. Coordinate with employees, reporting managers, and project leadership on HR-related matters. Manpower Planning Recruitment Coordinate manpower planning and recruitment activities for corporate offices and EPC project sites. Liaise with project managers, functional heads, and recruitment teams for manpower requirements. Monitor manpower deployment, vacancies, replacements, and recruitment status. Support recruitment of engineers, project managers, technical professionals, and site personnel. Maintain manpower MIS, recruitment trackers, and organizational charts. Payroll Compensation Administration Coordinate monthly payroll processing with Payroll and Finance teams. Ensure timely submission of attendance, leave, overtime, and payroll inputs. Monitor salary discrepancies, employee deductions, reimbursements, and payroll-related queries. Coordinate salary revision, increment, bonus, PLI, and compensation-related documentation. Ensure timely resolution of payroll discrepancies and employee concerns. HR Compliance Statutory Administration Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements at project sites and corporate offices. Coordinate PF, ESIC, gratuity, bonus, labour welfare fund, and other statutory matters, as applicable. Monitor contractor and third-party manpower compliance. Coordinate statutory audits, labour inspections, and compliance documentation. Maintain statutory records and ensure timely submission of compliance reports. HR Business Partnering Project Site Coordination Conduct regular HRBP visits to EPC project sites to assess HR and employee-related issues. Coordinate with Project Managers, Site HR, Site Admin, and functional teams. Monitor manpower availability, employee grievances, site discipline, and employee engagement. Identify site-level HR challenges and escalate critical issues to senior management. Support project leadership in people management and organizational effectiveness. Performance Management Employee Engagement Coordinate performance appraisal and annual increment processes. Monitor employee performance review submissions and follow-ups. Support employee engagement initiatives, recognition programs, and welfare activities. Coordinate training, development, and capability-building initiatives. Support employee retention, grievance handling, and disciplinary matters. HR MIS Management Reporting Prepare and circulate monthly HR MIS and manpower reports. Maintain employee headcount, attrition, recruitment, attendance, and payroll reports. Prepare HR dashboards and management presentations for senior leadership. Monitor HR KPIs and provide regular updates to the Reporting Manager and HR leadership. Support HR SPOC reporting and performance review initiatives. HR Policy Process Improvement Implement HR policies, procedures, and corporate guidelines. Ensure effective communication of HR policies to employees and project sites. Identify opportunities to improve HR processes, systems, and operational efficiency. Maintain HR documentation, process trackers, and audit-ready records. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Payroll Accuracy - Timely and error-free payroll inputs Recruitment TAT - Closure of manpower requirements within timelines Employee Documentation - 100% completion of employee records HR Compliance - Timely statutory compliance submissions Attendance Management - Accuracy and timely attendance closure HR MIS Reporting - Timely submission of reports Employee Grievance - Timely resolution of employee concerns HRBP Site Visits - Planned visits and closure of action points Attrition Management - Monitoring and reporting employee attrition Employee Engagement - Execution of engagement initiatives Educational Qualification MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent qualification. title: Senior Embedded Networking Engineer
description:
About the role We build and extend firmware for managed industrial Ethernet switches used in factories, utilities, transportation and other environments where the network cannot go down. You will work on the protocol stack at the heart of these switches: how frames are bridged, how loops are prevented, how a ring recovers within milliseconds when a link fails, and how traffic is routed between networks. The role suits a hands-on engineer who has shipped Layer 2 and Layer 3 features on real switch hardware, knows the standards well enough, and can trace a convergence problem from a packet capture down to the switch ASIC. Redundancy work, including Distributed RSTP (DRSTP) and recovery-time optimization, is a core part of the current work. 
 Key responsibilities Design, implement and maintain Layer 2 features on embedded switch platforms: VLANs, MAC learning and ageing, link aggregation (LACP), LLDP, IGMP/MLD snooping, port security and QoS. Own spanning-tree and redundancy features: STP, RSTP and MSTP, Distributed RSTP (DRSTP) and ring coupling, including analyzing and optimizing failover and recovery times. Design, implement and maintain Layer 3 features: static and dynamic routing (OSPF, RIP), ARP and neighbor discovery, VRRP, DHCP relay, IPv4 and IPv6 forwarding, and VRF where the platform supports it. Work across the control plane and data plane: integrate protocol software with the switch silicon through the vendor SDK (Broadcom, Marvell or similar), covering table programming, port and trunk configuration, CPU packet path, hardware events and link-state handling. Debug complex field and lab issues across the stack using packet captures, traffic generators, SDK diagnostics and kernel or system logs; drive root-cause analysis to closure. Write design documents and test plans; review code and designs from other engineers. Work with test teams on protocol conformance, interoperability and performance testing, including convergence-time measurement. Interact directly with customers on technical requirements, feasibility studies and issue resolution. Mentor junior engineers on networking concepts and embedded development practices. 
 Required experience and skills Experience 5 to 10 years of software development on Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking products, with at least 5 years on embedded switch or router platforms. A track record of shipping protocol features into production, not only maintaining them. 
 Layer 2 Strong working knowledge of IEEE 802.1D, 802.1w (RSTP), 802.1s (MSTP), 802.1Q and 802.1AX (LACP), including state machines, timers and edge cases. Hands-on experience with Distributed RSTP (DRSTP) or comparable redundancy schemes (for example multi-chassis link aggregation, IEEE 802.1AX DRNI, MRP/IEC 62439-2 or ERPS/G.8032), including tuning for fast recovery. Experience with LLDP, IGMP/MLD snooping, MAC table management and Layer 2 QoS. 
 Layer 3 Solid knowledge of IPv4 and IPv6 forwarding, ARP and neighbor discovery, static routing and at least one dynamic routing protocol (OSPF preferred). Experience with VRRP and DHCP relay. 
 Control plane and data plane Clear understanding of control plane, data plane and management plane separation on switches and routers, and how protocol state is programmed into hardware forwarding tables. Experience on the control plane: protocol state machines, the CPU packet path (trapping, punting and injecting control frames such as BPDUs, LACPDUs and routing packets), and control-plane policing. Experience on the data plane: programming MAC, VLAN, L3 host and route tables, ACLs and QoS in the ASIC, and handling hardware events such as link changes, table-full and learning events. Ability to debug mismatches between software state and hardware state, and to optimize the path from a control-plane decision to the data plane, which is critical for fast convergence. 
 Embedded and platform Expert C programming in a multi-threaded embedded environment; working knowledge of C++ and scripting (Python or shell). Embedded Linux: cross-compilation, build systems, kernel/user-space interaction, IPC and debugging with gdb and tracing tools. Experience with a switch ASIC SDK (Broadcom, Marvell or similar). Fluent with Wireshark, traffic generators (Ixia, Spirent or similar) and lab test setups. 
 Good to have Experience with industrial Ethernet switch platforms, for example Hirschmann HiOS, Moxa, Siemens SCALANCE or Cisco Industrial Ethernet. Familiarity with industrial redundancy and timing standards: IEC 62439 (MRP, HSR/PRP), IEEE 1588 PTP. Exposure to secure development practices, ideally IEC 62443-4-1/4-2. Management-plane work: CLI, SNMP/MIB design, web management, NETCONF/YANG. Experience connecting devices to cloud management platforms (TLS, MQTT, NATS or WebSockets). Prior customer-facing role in feasibility studies or effort estimation. 
 Interested? Apply here or drop your resume at apin.lal@gadgeon.com

title: Senior GLS Verification Engineer (ASIC / SoC)
description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for an experienced GLS Verification Engineer with 6+ years of hands-on experience in Gate-Level Simulation (GLS) and ASIC/SoC verification. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in gate-level simulation, post-synthesis and post-layout verification, timing-aware simulation, SDF annotation, X-propagation analysis and debugging. The candidate will be responsible for validating gate-level netlists, identifying functional and timing-related issues, and ensuring design readiness for silicon tape-out. 
 Key Responsibilities Drive gate-level simulation and verification activities for complex ASIC and SoC designs. Perform GLS at different stages of the design flow, including post-synthesis and post-physical design. Develop and execute GLS test plans and simulation scenarios based on design specifications. Perform zero-delay and timing-annotated simulations using SDF (Standard Delay Format). Analyse and debug functional mismatches between RTL and gate-level simulations. Identify and resolve X-propagation issues, timing violations and race conditions. Perform reset and clock sequencing checks, including asynchronous reset behaviour. Debug setup and hold-related simulation failures and timing-related functional issues. Work closely with RTL Design, Design Verification, STA, DFT and Physical Design teams to resolve design issues. Analyse simulation logs, waveforms and timing reports to identify root causes. Develop and maintain GLS regression environments and automation scripts. Ensure adequate simulation coverage for critical design scenarios. Support post-synthesis and post-layout verification sign-off activities. Participate in design reviews, verification closure and tape-out readiness assessments. 

 Mandatory Technical Skills 
 6+ years of experience in ASIC / SoC verification, with strong hands-on expertise in Gate-Level Simulation. Strong understanding of GLS methodologies and gate-level netlist verification. Excellent knowledge of Verilog and SystemVerilog. Hands-on experience with SDF annotation and timing-aware GLS. Experience in post-synthesis and post-layout gate-level simulations. Strong understanding of X-propagation, unknown-state analysis and debugging. Experience in debugging RTL versus gate-level simulation mismatches. Understanding of setup and hold timing, clock domains, reset synchronisation and timing checks. Knowledge of SDF back-annotation, specify blocks and timing checks. Strong debugging skills using simulation logs, waveforms and relevant reports. Understanding of ASIC/SoC design flow, synthesis and physical design processes. 
 EDA Tools 
 Experience with one or more of the following tools: Synopsys VCS Cadence Xcelium Siemens Questa / ModelSim Synopsys Verdi Cadence SimVision Synopsys Design Compiler Cadence Genus 

 Scripting and Automation 
 Good experience with Shell scripting. Working knowledge of Python, Perl or Tcl. Ability to automate GLS regression execution, log analysis and failure reporting. Experience in developing scripts to improve simulation and debugging efficiency. 
 Good to Have Skills Experience in low-power GLS and UPF-based verification. Knowledge of power-aware simulation and isolation/retention cell behaviour. Exposure to scan-enabled and DFT-related gate-level simulations. Experience with post-route GLS and timing-annotated netlists. Knowledge of SDC constraints and Static Timing Analysis (STA). Exposure to multi-clock and multi-reset domain designs. Experience with emulation or hardware-assisted verification. Understanding of ECO verification and post-ECO simulation. 
 Education Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, VLSI or a related discipline.

title: Senior Software Engineering Manager, Product Security
description:
Senior Software Engineering Manager, Product Security This role has been designed as Hybrid with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office. About the Role As a Senior Software Engineering Manager within HPE s Product Security Office (PSO), you will build and lead a high-performing development team responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and operating secure, reliable, and scalable software. Your team will deliver applications, platforms, APIs, automation, and integrations that enable product teams to identify, manage, and reduce security risk across the product lifecycle. This is a build-and-scale people leadership role. You will create the team environment, delivery discipline, and engineering practices needed to turn product security priorities into dependable capabilities used across HPE. You will set clear priorities, develop engineering talent, establish repeatable operating mechanisms, and ensure the team delivers measurable outcomes with strong security, quality, reliability, and maintainability. Operating within PSO s matrixed model, you will balance shared engineering capacity across multiple product security capabilities, partnering with capability owners who define business outcomes and priorities while retaining accountability for people leadership, engineering execution, and technical delivery. You will bring enough technical depth to guide decisions, challenge approaches, review engineering quality, and remove obstacles while holding engineers accountable for technical ownership and execution. You will partner with PSO leaders, product and capability owners, architects, program managers, product engineering teams, and adjacent cybersecurity organizations to align roadmaps, manage dependencies, and scale solutions across diverse product environments. The role manages individual contributors and succeeds by building a capable team-not by acting as the primary architect or personally owning every technical decision. 
 What you ll do: Build and Lead the Engineering Team Hire, onboard, lead, and develop a team of individual-contributor software and security engineers, setting clear expectations, goals, development plans, and accountability for results. Create an inclusive, high-trust engineering culture grounded in ownership, collaboration, technical excellence, continuous learning, and constructive challenge. Provide regular coaching, feedback, career development, and performance support while building succession strength and expanding the team s technical capabilities. Match work to skills and development needs, delegate meaningful ownership, and ensure senior engineers lead design and implementation within clear decision boundaries. Plan team capacity, workload, and skill coverage; identify resourcing risks and recommend hiring, development, or partner strategies. 
 Drive Engineering Delivery and Operations Translate Product Security Office priorities and capability roadmaps into clear engineering plans, milestones, ownership, and measurable outcomes. Lead day-to-day engineering execution, including prioritization, sprint and release planning, dependency management, risk tracking, escalation, and delivery reviews. Ensure the team builds and operates secure, reliable, maintainable, and scalable software, services, automation, APIs, data integrations, and product security tooling. Establish effective engineering practices for design review, source control, testing, CI/CD, secure development, release management, observability, incident response, and operational support. Balance new capability development with operational reliability, technical debt reduction, defect remediation, platform modernization, and lifecycle maintenance. Define and monitor meaningful measures for delivery predictability, quality, reliability, security, adoption, and engineering effectiveness. 
 Shape Product Security Capabilities Partner with product and capability owners to understand user needs, clarify requirements, prioritize engineering investments, and sequence delivery across the Product Security Office capability portfolio. Guide development of reusable product security platforms and services that improve vulnerability management, security assessment, secure development, reporting, workflow automation, or related security outcomes. Promote automation and responsible use of AI-assisted engineering where they improve speed, consistency, coverage, or user experience while preserving validation, traceability, security, and human accountability. Ensure security, privacy, data-handling, resilience, and compliance considerations are incorporated into solution design and delivery. Use stakeholder feedback, operational data, and engineering insights to identify opportunities for simplification, reuse, integration, and continuous improvement. 
 Lead Across Teams and Boundaries Build strong working relationships across Product Security, product engineering, security research, vulnerability response, infrastructure, architecture, and enterprise technology teams. Align stakeholders on priorities, scope, tradeoffs, dependencies, and delivery commitments, escalating material risks with clear options and recommendations. Provide transparent capacity, dependency, and engineering investment tradeoffs across the PSO portfolio, helping leadership determine when capabilities should be built, integrated, scaled, modernized, consolidated, or retired. Coordinate effectively with globally distributed teams and partners while establishing clear ownership, handoffs, documentation, and operating rhythms. Communicate engineering progress, risks, decisions, and outcomes clearly to technical teams, product leaders, and senior stakeholders. Represent the team in planning, architecture, operational, and leadership forums while ensuring individual contributors retain appropriate technical visibility and ownership. 
 What you need to bring: Bachelors or Masters degree in computer science, software engineering, cybersecurity, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Typically 10 or more years of relevant software engineering, security engineering, or technology experience, including 3+ years of people management experience directly managing software engineers. Proven experience leading teams that design, build, release, and operate enterprise software, platforms, services, automation, or developer-facing capabilities. Demonstrated ability to manage individual contributors, develop talent, set clear priorities, address performance issues, and create accountability for delivery and engineering quality. Experience establishing or improving engineering practices across software design, code review, testing, CI/CD, secure development, release management, observability, and operational support. Experience managing roadmaps, delivery plans, dependencies, technical debt, operational risk, and competing stakeholder priorities in a complex or matrixed organization. Strong technical understanding of modern software architecture, APIs, cloud environments, containers, data platforms, source control, CI/CD, and secure software development practices. Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and tradeoffs to non-technical audiences. 
 Preferred Qualifications Experience leading globally distributed engineering teams and collaborating across time zones, cultures, and organizational boundaries. Experience with Python, Java, JavaScript or TypeScript, React, Node.js, SQL or NoSQL data platforms, REST APIs, Linux, GitHub, Jenkins or GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, or comparable technologies. Experience applying AI-assisted development, intelligent automation, or agentic methods within secure engineering workflows, including appropriate validation and human oversight. Experience improving engineering operating models, building a new team or capability, or scaling a platform from project-based delivery to sustainable operations. Working knowledge of common software weaknesses, OWASP guidance, threat modeling, software supply-chain security, and secure development lifecycle principles. Relevant engineering, cloud, agile, or security certifications are helpful but not required. 
 What Success Looks Like A capable, engaged engineering team has clear priorities, meaningful ownership, strong development support, and accountability for outcomes. Product security capabilities move from ambiguous needs to predictable delivery through clear roadmaps, operating rhythms, engineering standards, and decision ownership. Software and automation are secure, reliable, maintainable, measurable, and supported through disciplined lifecycle and operational practices. Product and capability owners have a trusted engineering partner that provides transparent delivery commitments, credible tradeoffs, and timely escalation of risks. Reusable platforms, integrations, automation, and engineering practices reduce fragmentation and improve the scale and effectiveness of Product Security Office capabilities. The team becomes increasingly self-sufficient as engineers grow in technical ownership, judgment, collaboration, and leadership. Accessibility

title: Electrical and Maintenance Engineer
description:
Profile Summary : Looking for maintenance department team. Freshers can also apply. Shifts will be there. 
 Key Roles & Responsibilities A. Daily Breakdown & Corrective Maintenance Attend and support the maintenance team during machine breakdowns . Assist in identifying and troubleshooting electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic faults. Coordinate with technicians for timely restoration of equipment. Support root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring breakdowns. Record breakdown details, downtime, action taken, and restoration time. Monitor breakdown trends and identify opportunities for reducing machine downtime. Ensure maintenance activities are carried out safely and as per standard procedures. Escalate critical or repeated equipment failures to the Maintenance Engineer / Manager. B. Preventive & Autonomous Maintenance (PM / AM) Support the preparation and execution of Preventive Maintenance (PM) schedules. Carry out routine machine inspections as per checklists. Assist in checking lubrication, fasteners, belts, bearings, sensors, motors, switches, cylinders, hoses, and other components. Support Autonomous Maintenance (AM) activities along with production operators. Ensure scheduled maintenance activities are completed within the planned timeline. Identify abnormal conditions such as unusual noise, vibration, leakage, overheating, and loose connections. Assist in monitoring equipment health and identifying potential failures before breakdown. Maintain records of completed PM and AM activities. C. Spares & Utility Management Assist in maintaining maintenance spare inventory . Monitor availability of critical electrical and mechanical spares. Support identification of minimum and maximum stock levels for critical spares. Maintain records of spare parts issued, received, and consumed. Coordinate with stores and purchase teams for spare requirements. Assist in maintaining records of motors, pumps, sensors, bearings, valves, electrical components, pneumatic components, etc. Support monitoring of plant utilities such as air compressors, cooling systems, pumps, electrical systems, and other utility equipment . Report abnormal utility consumption or equipment conditions to the concerned engineer. D. Maintenance Documentation & Support Maintain daily maintenance reports and breakdown records. Update Preventive Maintenance (PM) records and checklists . Maintain machine history and equipment maintenance records. Assist in preparing MTBF and MTTR reports. Support preparation of monthly maintenance performance reports. Maintain records of breakdowns, corrective actions, spare consumption, and pending maintenance activities. Assist in updating SOPs, work instructions, checklists, and maintenance standards. Support maintenance audits and compliance activities. Assist in maintaining equipment-related documents, drawings, manuals, and technical records. 4. Additional Responsibilities Follow all safety, quality, environmental, and company procedures . Support 5S activities within the maintenance area and shop floor. Participate in continuous improvement and Kaizen activities. Assist in identifying opportunities for reducing breakdowns, downtime, energy consumption, and maintenance costs. Coordinate effectively with Production, Quality, Stores, Purchase, and other departments. Participate in technical training and skill-development programs. Perform other maintenance-related responsibilities assigned by the reporting manager. 5. Technical Skills Required Basic knowledge of Electrical and Mechanical Maintenance . Basic understanding of: Motors and control panels Sensors and switches PLC basics Hydraulic systems Pneumatic systems Bearings, belts, chains, couplings, and gearboxes Pumps and compressors Preventive maintenance Troubleshooting techniques Knowledge of MS Office, particularly Excel and Word . Basic understanding of maintenance documentation and reporting. Ability to read basic electrical and mechanical drawings will be an advantage. 6. Behavioural & Soft Skills Good problem-solving and analytical skills. Willingness to learn and work on the shop floor. Good communication and coordination skills. Ability to work effectively with technicians and operators. Positive attitude and willingness to take responsibility. Ability to work under pressure during breakdown situations. Good observation and attention to detail. Teamwork and discipline. Willingness to work in shifts, if required. 7. Educational Qualification Essential: B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical / Electrical & Electronics / Mechanical / Mechatronics / related engineering discipline . Experience: Fresher/ 01 year experience. Candidates with manufacturing or industrial maintenance exposure will be an advantage. 8. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The GET's performance may be evaluated based on: Preventive Maintenance completion percentage Breakdown response and restoration support Reduction in machine downtime Accuracy of maintenance records Spare inventory control MTBF improvement MTTR reduction PM/AM checklist compliance 5S and safety compliance Participation in Kaizen / continuous improvement activities.

title: Engineering Delivery Manager
description:
Job Summary 
 We are currently seeking an Engineering Delivery Manager to join the Decommissioning market within our Nuclear EMEA business. Our market provides our clients with sustainable engineered solutions to plant life extension, waste retrieval as well as dismantling and demolition problems across the full project life cycle including commissioning and operation. We can offer our own products and technology to provide innovative solutions that accelerate the pace of change and provide resource augmentation to support our clients and partners. 
 We have strong capabilities in the holistic design, assessment and substantiation of assets including chemical processes, process equipment and control systems, piping and pressure vessels, safety instrumented systems, mechanical handling equipment, structures, low voltage electrical power systems and building services. We tackle projects that have varied technical challenges and significant nuclear and conventional safety hazards. Our projects require proactive and collaborative working to brilliantly engineer a cleaner, safer, net zero world. 
 We continually invest in our people, technology, working facilities and supporting resources to ensure that we strengthen and grow our current capabilities as well as develop new capabilities. This allows us to deliver projects using industry leading and innovative techniques, such as utilising our growing technology solutions and robotics capabilities and showing that our solutions work through active demonstrators. 
 

 Your role 
 
 You will be accountable to the Engineering Delivery Lead for the engineering design, assessment and substantiation of technical complex nuclear decommissioning and waste management projects within a portfolio. 
 You will act as the Technical Governance Manager for the portfolio, and as such you will oversee the identification, management, and communication of technical risks throughout each project's life cycle, including bid phase. You will collate and manage portfolio technical risk and escalate to the Engineering Director where appropriate. 
 You will ensure consistent application of our Nuclear EMEA technical governance frameworks. 
 You will monitor the delivery of Engineering project activities and deliverables against cost and schedule and coach Project Engineering Managers to implement corrective action to achieve project milestones. 
 You will support Project Managers in defining Engineering resource requirements and mobilisation plans, and lead Engineering mobilisation activities for new projects and opportunities within the assigned portfolio. Working with Engineering Capability and delivery teams, you will identify resource constraints, recommend interventions where delivery performance is at risk, and escalate significant resource and mobilisation risks to the Engineering Delivery Lead. 
 You will support and coach Project Engineering Managers to strive for delivery excellence and identify and mentor future technical leaders in collaboration with their Capability Lead. 
 You will act as Project Engineering Manager or Technical Lead for the delivery of engineering design, assessment and substantiation of assets within technical complex nuclear decommissioning and waste management projects. 
 
 

 About you 
 
 The ideal candidate will possess a solid background in technical leadership, ensuring that our Project Engineering Managers have visible guidance. 
 You will have a comprehensive grasp of engineering in nuclear decommissioning encompassing plant life extension, waste retrieval as well as dismantlement and demolition. 
 You will be a proponent of our systems-based approach and rigorous in the application of our technical governance frameworks to ensure we deliver to the highest standards. 
 You will have a proficient understanding of risk assessment and management techniques to identify, mitigate, and communicate technical risks throughout the project lifecycle. 
 You will have leadership skills to guide and mentor project engineering managers, ensuring alignment with business objectives. 
 Problem-solving skills to address complex technical complexities and find effective solutions. 
 Communication skills to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate with various stakeholders. Proficiency in quality assurance processes to ensure the technical integrity and reliability of project deliverables. 
 You will demonstrate integrity and ethical behaviour in all professional interactions and decisions. Collaborate with stakeholders to align technology initiatives with business goals. Be adaptable and open to change within evolving environments. Foster a culture of innovation, promoting creativity and new ideas. Commit to continuous learning and professional development to keep up with changing technology. 
 
 

 How will you contribute to the team 
 
 An innovator - You will encourage people to experiment, produce new ideas and challenge others to think differently. You'll create space for people to think about potential new innovative approaches, providing an opportunity for growth. 
 An Improver - You spend time on making the processes, methods, and toolsets more efficient, optimising your resources to be able to deliver better. 
 A Visible Leader - You striving to produce work of the highest standard and quality will inspire colleagues. 
 Fully integrated with counterparts in other parts of the business and active in identifying cross-application of skills, best practice and learning material. 
 Excellent team player, able to collaborate effectively with market colleagues, wider business colleagues and the senior leadership team.

Key Skills: Project,Low Voltage,Press,Piping,Equipment,Quality assurance,Energy,Pressure

description:
Location: Ghaziabad Company: Alstom 

 Job Summary 
 At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars. Could you be the full-time Lead PI Engineer in Duhai were looking for. 

 Your Role, Your Impact 
 Lead performance improvement initiatives across traction and braking systems to enhance scalability and operational efficiency. Collaborate with cross-functional engineering and maintenance teams to ensure seamless integration of subsystems and data-driven decision-making. Ensure reliability through root cause analysis, system validation, and continuous monitoring using Alstoms PI tools and methodologies. Drive innovation by implementing predictive maintenance strategies and leveraging digital analytics platforms for performance optimization. Promote knowledge sharing by documenting best practices and mentoring junior engineers in system performance analysis. Years of exp - 4 Years + You'll work with sharp, committed teams solving complex challenges that shape the future of mobility, ensuring seamless integration of business and technology. 

 What You Bring 
 Strong understanding of traction, braking, and onboard control systems within rail applications. Experience with data acquisition tools such as PI Historian or MATLAB for performance analysis. Ability to interpret system-level KPIs and translate findings into actionable engineering improvements. Knowledge of RAMS (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, Safety) principles and their application in rail systems. Proficiency in using root cause analysis frameworks like 8D or FMEA to resolve technical issues. 

 Educational Requirements 

 Mandatory 
 Graduate in Engineering or Industrial Internal EHS training English 

 Desirable 
 Masters degree in Engineering 

 How Success Is Measured 
 Achievement of performance improvement targets and adherence to delivery timelines. Effective collaboration across engineering, maintenance, and operations teams. Reduction in system defects and measurable gains in operational efficiency. Important to note As a global business, were an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. Were committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

title: Production Engineer - PPC
description:
The Production Engineer plans and controls daily production on the shop floor. The goal is to dispatch every machine on time, at the right quality, at planned cost. The role turns sales orders into a workable production plan. It then makes sure people, material and machines are ready to carry it out. Key responsibilities Production planning Prepare the weekly and monthly production plan from confirmed sales orders and dispatch dates. Break each machine into fabrication, machining, painting and assembly jobs. Estimate the man-hours and machine hours each job needs. Flag capacity gaps early and propose overtime, extra shifts or subcontracting. Scheduling and job allocation Allocate daily jobs to fitters, welders, painters and helpers. Track every job against its plan date. Re-plan when priorities change. Coordinate outside work (machining, fabrication) sent to sub-contractors, including S S Engineers. Material planning Check BOMs and drawings against stock before a job is released. Raise material requests to Stores and Purchase on time. Follow up shortages so that no job waits for material. Shop floor control Hold a short shop floor meeting at the start of each shift. Ensure workers follow drawings, process sheets and safety rules. Make sure PPE is used and the shop is kept clean and in order. Report breakdowns of cranes, welding machines and cutting machines to maintenance. Coordination Work with Design on drawing questions and revisions. Work with Quality on stage inspection and rework. Work with Sales and Service on dispatch dates and site needs. Plan loading and dispatch with Stores and Logistics. ERP and records Create and update work orders, job cards and timesheets in the ERP. Verify shop floor timesheets against biometric punch records. Keep production records, rework records and machine history up to date. Reporting and improvement Send a daily production report: jobs completed, pending, and reasons for delay. Present a weekly plan-versus-actual review to management. Find ways to cut cycle time, rework and material waste. Qualification and experience B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical or Production Engineering. 1 to 3 years in production, PPC or shop floor work. Profiles with more than 3 years will not be considered. Experience in heavy fabrication, structural or machine-building work is preferred. Exposure to crushing, mining or material-handling equipment is an added advantage. Skills and attributes Technical Reads mechanical and fabrication drawings, including GD&T and weld symbols. Understands fabrication, welding, machining, painting and assembly processes. Can read a BOM and calculate material needs. Works with ERP software and MS Excel. Knows basic shop floor safety practice. Personal Leads a shop floor team firmly and fairly. Plans ahead and follows up until the job is closed. Communicates clearly in Tamil and English. Hindi is an advantage, since part of the team speaks Hindi. Stays calm under dispatch pressure. Is disciplined about time and records. Lead .NET Engineer (React) Engineering - Hyderabad, Telangana About Gradera Digital Twin & Physical AI Platform At Gradera, we are building a next-generation Digital Twin and Physical AI platform that enables enterprises to model, simulate, and optimize complex real-world systems. Our work brings together strategy, architecture, data, simulation, and experience design to power decision-making across large-scale operational environments such as manufacturing, logistics, and supply chain networks. This platform-led initiative applies AI-native execution, advanced simulation, and governed orchestration to help organizations test scenarios, predict outcomes, and continuously improve performance. We operate with an enterprise-first mindset prioritizing reliability, transparency, and measurable business impact as we build intelligent systems that scale beyond a single industry or use case. 
 Overview We are seeking a high-caliber Lead .Net Engineer to join our Digital Twin Platform and Simulation team. In this role, you will translate high-level architectural visions into robust, executable low-level designs (LLD) . You will be the technical anchor for the squad by providing deep technical guidance and maintaining rigorous standards you will enable the team to deliver scalable interfaces and services that power our digital twin ecosystem. 
 Our Core Full Stack Front-End Engineering React for building complex, state-heavy interactive dashboards JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript for type-safe management of simulation data State management (Redux/Zustand) optimized for high-frequency data updates Back-End & Microservices .Net and Spring Boot for building high-scale, resilient microservices REST APIs for seamless communication between services and front-end consumers Microservices architecture and system integration patterns Engineering Excellence GitHub for version control and rigorous Code Reviews CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and Kubernetes for cloud-native deployment 
 
 
 Key Responsibilities Low-Level Design (LLD): Convert high-level architectural blueprints into detailed technical designs, including class diagrams, sequence diagrams, and API specifications. Technical Mentoring: Lead and coach the engineering team through pair programming, technical 1-on-1s, and hands-on guidance to elevate overall team competency. Standards Enforcement: Ensure all code adheres to the defined engineering standards, SOLID principles, and design patterns established by the Architects. Code Quality & Review: Conduct comprehensive code reviews to maintain high quality, ensuring the team delivers clean, testable, and maintainable code. Technical Anchoring: Serve as the "go-to" expert for the squad to resolve complex technical blockers and provide clarity on implementation details. Hands-on Development: Direct implementation of critical and complex modules, setting the benchmark for performance and reliability. System Integration: Oversee the technical execution of integrations between full-stack applications and core data layers (Databricks/Neo4j). Delivery Governance: Ensure the squad meets sprint objectives by maintaining a high standard of execution and managing technical debt effectively. 
 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 8 to 10 years of professional experience in full-stack software development. Proven track record in a Tech Lead capacity, with strong experience in creating Low-Level Designs . Expert-level proficiency in .Net, Spring Boot , and React . Deep understanding of Microservices architecture and RESTful API design. Demonstrated ability to mentor engineering teams and drive technical excellence in an Agile environment. Experience working in the India tech region, preferably within high-growth product engineering teams. 
 
 
 Highly Desirable Experience building platforms for Digital Twin, IoT, or Simulation environments. Familiarity with visualizing complex networks or real-time operational data. Knowledge of performance tuning for both front-end rendering and back-end processing. Experience leading teams in an Agile/Scrum environment. Exposure to industrial domains such as Manufacturing, Logistics, or Transportation is a plus.

title: Senior Human Resource Executive
description:
Job Title: Senior HR Executive 
 Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka- Jigani Experience: 5 to 8 Years Industry Preference: Manufacturing / Aerospace Precision Machining / Industrial Engineering Language Requirement: English & Kannada (Mandatory) for shop-floor operations and worker engagement; Hindi can manage. 

 Role Overview We are seeking a hands-on Senior HR Executive to manage end-to-end Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, Payroll Processing, Statutory Labour Compliance, Plant Administration, and Shop-Floor Employee Relations. This role requires ~50% focus on Recruitment across plant/shop-floor and corporate levels, combined with strong expertise in generalist HR, statutory filings, and manufacturing plant floor operations. Key Responsibilities 1. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition (~50% Focus) Manage full lifecycle recruitment for technical, operator, supervisory, and managerial positions. Source candidates via job portals, employee referrals, local industrial networks, ITIs/diploma technical institutes, and consultants. Conduct initial screenings, schedule interviews, coordinate technical evaluations, and negotiate offers. Onboard new hires on the shop floor and office, ensuring documentation, background verification, and orientation. Build talent pipelines for critical shop-floor roles (CNC Operators, Machinists [Turning/Milling/Grinding], Fitters, Technicians, Quality & NDT Engineers). 2. Statutory & Labour Law Compliance Ensure 100% adherence to factory labour laws, statutory provisions, and Karnataka state government regulations (Factories Act / OSH Code, Karnataka Labour Regulations). Manage monthly statutory deductions, remittances, and return filings for EPF, ESI, Professional Tax (PT), and Labour Welfare Fund (LWF) . Maintain all mandatory physical and digital statutory registers (Mustering Register, Wage Register, Overtime Register, Leave with Wages, Adult Worker Register, Accident Register). Prepare periodic half-yearly and annual statutory returns for Factory Inspectors and Labour Commissioners. Coordinate and assist during Factory Inspections, Labour Department Audits, and Statutory Audits . Monitor contractor Labour Compliance (CLRA Act), verifying contractor EPF/ESI challans, wage slips, and attendance before passing invoices. 3. Shop-Floor HR & Employee Relations Act as the primary HR liaison for shop-floor technicians, machinists, operators, and factory personnel. Handle daily shop-floor operations, resolve worker grievances, and maintain positive industrial relations. Communicate plant policies, safety guidelines, and workplace standards fluently in Kannada and English (Hindi support where necessary). Drive plant safety awareness, employee engagement programs, wellness initiatives, and Reward & Recognition (R&R) schemes. 4. Payroll & Time/Attendance Management Maintain daily biometric attendance, shift rosters, leave records, and overtime calculations. Prepare accurate monthly payroll inputs (attendance, deductions, allowances, bonuses, statutory cuts). Coordinate bonus calculations (Payment of Bonus Act) and Gratuity tracking. 5. General HR & Performance Management Support the annual and mid-year performance appraisal process across plant departments. Maintain employee master data, HR files, and compliance records for audit readiness ( AS9100 / ISO / Nadcap / EHS standards ). Coordinate EHS (Environmental Health & Safety), technical skills, and POSH training programs, maintaining training hours records. 6. Administration & Plant Facilities Oversight Oversee plant facility management, including security, housekeeping, and factory canteen operations. Manage employee transportation/cab logistics for shift workers. Handle vendor contracts, purchase orders, and invoice approvals for HR and plant admin services. Assist in factory licensing, visitor management, and health & welfare amenities maintenance (drinking water, first aid, safety gear). Key Candidate Requirements Experience: 58 years of HR Generalist / HR Executive experience in a manufacturing plant environment. Education: Bachelors degree in HR, Business Administration, or related field (MBA/PGDM in HR preferred). Language Skills: Fluency in English and Kannada is MANDATORY for shop-floor management. Working knowledge of Hindi is preferred . Statutory Knowledge: Hands-on experience with Factory Act / Labour Codes, EPF, ESIC, PT, LWF, Bonus, Gratuity, and CLRA statutory compliance. Technical Skills: Advanced MS Excel, MS Word, HRMS software, and biometric attendance systems. Soft Skills: Strong interpersonal communication, conflict resolution, negotiation, and audit handling skills.

Key Skills: Coding,Talent acquisition,Processing,Labour,Statutory,Performance management,Management,Coordination

Only candidates who can relocate or are local and are immediate joiners must apply. Work from Home for this profile is not available. The Human Resource Executive must be able to work in a fast-paced environment where priorities change constantly. They should have a positive can-do attitude and not be afraid to roll up their sleeves to tackle a project. Responsibilities Act as the main point of contact on all people-related matters. Maintain employee relations by partnering with management and being a resource for employees at every level while focusing on employee engagement, policy creation/maintenance, and resolution of grievances. Lead full-cycle recruitment and onboarding, including sourcing, agency relationships, interviewing, reference/background checks, new hire paperwork, orientation, etc. Manage employee payroll and benefits, including broker/vendor relationships, enrollment, claims resolution, general employee inquiries, and invoice processing. Lead the annual review process by partnering with management and employees to conduct training, providing advice throughout the process, and calibrate ratings and compensation with management. Manage HRIS, including reporting, employee data changes, and requests. Handle employee off-boarding, including exit interview, paperwork, system deactivation, final paycheck, equipment collection, etc. Monitor all employee time off, including vacation and sick leave. Maintain the employee work rules and recommend new approaches, policies, and procedures. Oversee administrative management office, including being the main point of contact for building management. Participate in other team projects and company initiatives as need be. Own delivery for client-facing web, mobile, AI, cloud or digital transformation work based on the role. Collaborate with project managers, designers, QA and client stakeholders through discovery, build, launch and support. Write clear documentation, communicate risks early and keep delivery quality high. Contribute to reusable engineering practices, reviews and mentoring inside the WebSenor team. What we're looking for Strong hands-on experience relevant to this role and a portfolio of shipped production work. Clear communication, ownership mindset and ability to work with global clients. Comfort with delivery discipline: estimation, reviews, testing, documentation and release readiness. Ability to learn fast and work across modern product, engineering and AI-enabled workflows. title: Manager - Human Resource (Operations & Payroll)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION 
 Department Human Resource 
 Designation Manager 
 Location: Mumbai 
 Experience: 810 Years 
 Role Overview 
 The Manager HR Operations & Payroll will be responsible for managing the end-to-end HR operations, 
 payroll processing, statutory compliance, employee compensation, attendance management, incentives 
 and variable pay administration. 
 The role requires strong hands-on experience in payroll management, HRMS administration (KEKA), 
 employee lifecycle management, statutory compliances, taxation and advanced Excel. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Payroll Management 
 Manage end-to-end monthly payroll processing, ensuring accuracy and timely salary disbursement. 
Validate monthly payroll inputs, salary revisions, new joiners, exits, LOP, reimbursements, deductions and arrears. 
 Handle full and final settlements (F&F), notice pay, leave encashment and exit-related payroll adjustments. 
 Reconcile payroll data and resolve salary discrepancies. 
 Coordinate with Finance and Accounts for payroll processing, salary disbursement and accounting reconciliation. 
 Maintain payroll records, salary registers and employee compensation data. 
 2. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle Management 
 Manage complete employee lifecycle activities, including onboarding, documentation, 
 confirmation, transfers, promotions, salary revisions and employee exits. 
 ¢ Ensure employee records, personal files and HR documentation are accurate and updated. 
 ¢ Manage employee letters, HR documentation, employment certificates and other HR-related 
 communication. 
 ¢ Maintain accurate employee databases and manpower records across locations. 
 
 3. Statutory Compliance & Taxation 
 ¢ Ensure compliance with applicable statutory requirements, including PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, 
 Labour Welfare Fund, TDS and other applicable labour laws. 
 ¢ Coordinate monthly and annual statutory filings, challans, returns and reconciliations. 
 ¢ Manage employee investment declarations, proof submissions and tax-related payroll calculations. 
 ¢ Handle Form 16, TDS calculations and employee tax queries. 
 ¢ Coordinate with statutory auditors, consultants and government authorities whenever required. 
 ¢ Maintain compliance records and ensure timely completion of statutory obligations. 
 4. Incentive & Variable Pay Management 
 ¢ Manage end-to-end calculation, validation and processing of employee incentives, performance- 
 linked pay and variable compensation. 
 ¢ Validate incentive eligibility, achievement data, payout calculations and approvals in coordination 
 with Business Heads. 
 ¢ Maintain incentive MIS, payout trackers and reconciliation reports. 
 5. Attendance & Leave Management 
 ¢ Monitor employee attendance, shift schedules, leave balances, weekly offs, late marks and loss of 
 pay. 
 ¢ Ensure accurate attendance inputs for monthly payroll processing. 
 ¢ Coordinate with respective departments and reporting managers for attendance regularization and 
 discrepancies. 
 ¢ Ensure timely closure of attendance inputs before monthly payroll processing. 
 6. Employee Helpdesk 
 ¢ Act as the primary point of contact for employee queries related to payroll, taxation, attendance, 
 leave, incentives, HR policies and HRMS. 
 ¢ Handle employee grievances and operational escalations professionally. 
 ¢ Ensure effective communication of HR policies, processes and employee-related updates. 
 ¢ Maintain query trackers and monitor resolution timelines. 
 7. MIS, Reporting & Process Improvement 
 ¢ Prepare and publish monthly HR MIS covering payroll, attendance, manpower, attrition, employee 
 movements and statutory compliance. 
 ¢ Develop advanced Excel-based reports, dashboards and trackers. 
 ¢ Perform data analysis, reconciliation and validation to ensure accuracy. 
 ¢ Prepare periodic reports for HR leadership and senior management. 
 
 Educational, Experience & Professional Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Management or a related discipline. 
 MBA / PGDM in HR or equivalent qualification. 
 Experience: 
 ¢ 810 years of experience in HR Operations & Payroll. 
 ¢ Strong hands-on experience in end-to-end payroll and statutory compliance. 
 ¢ Good knowledge of PF, ESIC, PT, TDS and employee taxation. 
 ¢ Experience in incentive, variable pay and attendance management. 
 ¢ Mandatory: Hands-on experience with KEKA HRMS portal. 
 Technical Skills: 
 ¢ Advanced MS Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, IF, SUMIFS and MIS dashboards). 
 ¢ Strong knowledge of payroll systems, HRMS and reporting. 
 Key Competencies: 
 ¢ Strong analytical and numerical skills. 
 ¢ High attention to detail and accuracy. 
 ¢ Good communication, coordination and employee query-handling skills. 
 ¢ Ability to manage confidential employee data.

description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet. Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you re in the right place. About you and this role Dow has an exciting opportunity for a Human Resources Continuous Improvement Lead ! This position can be located in Midland , Houston , Terneuzen , Sao Paulo , Mumbai or Shanghai . In this role, you will enable a culture of continuous improvement across HR Service Delivery by establishing the governance, tools, methodologies, reporting, and delivery practices that support improvement initiatives across disciplines. Working closely with discipline leaders and key stakeholders, you will ensure improvement opportunities are prioritized, managed, measured, and executed consistently while providing visibility into progress, outcomes, resource utilization, and business impact. You will serve as a strategic enabler by providing project management, change management, performance improvement, and technology frameworks that allow disciplines to successfully identify, execute, and sustain improvements. You will also serve as an influential leader to the Citizen Developer team and be accountable for capacity planning, work prioritization, delivery governance, and capability development. Additionally, you will act as the operational excellence center of expertise for HR Service Delivery, enabling business-led improvement initiatives through robust governance, methodologies, analytics, project delivery capabilities, and technology enablement. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Establish and maintain processes, standards, and governance models that enable consistent improvement, automation, and technology initiatives across HR Service Delivery. Serve as an influential leader to the Citizen Developer team, providing oversight for resource planning, work intake, prioritization, capacity management, governance, and delivery execution. Manage and monitor the portfolio of HR improvement initiatives, ensuring alignment of resources, priorities, timelines, dependencies, and organizational objectives. Develop and maintain continuous improvement frameworks, operating procedures, templates, and best practices that support consistent execution and sustainable results. Enable discipline to execute continuous improvement initiatives by providing methodologies, tools, facilitation, governance, and delivery support. Facilitate structured problem-solving, project planning, and improvement activities to help teams effectively address operational challenges and opportunities. Drive standardization of improvement practices across disciplines, ensuring a common approach to prioritization, measurement, execution, and reporting. Evaluate, implement, and govern improvement solutions that enable process optimization, workflow efficiency, operational visibility, and scalable service delivery. Maintain governance and standards for improvements delivered through Citizen Development and other continuous improvement channels. Support disciplines in assessing and leveraging automation, self-service, reporting, and digital solutions to improve operational effectiveness. Define and promote best practices, standards, and tools for project management, change management, continuous improvement, and solution implementation. Provide consulting, coaching, and guidance to project teams and discipline leaders on improvement methodologies, project governance, stakeholder engagement, and change adoption. Ensure improvement initiatives incorporate appropriate change management practices to support successful adoption and long-term sustainability. 
 
 Required Qualifications 
 A minimum of a bachelors degree or relevant military experience at or above a U.S. E5 or Canadian Petty Officer 2nd Class or Sergeant ranking. A minimum of 4 years of relevant working experience. Must be willing and able to work a flexible schedule as needed in order to collaborate during US business hours. For U.S. Applicants: A minimum requirement for this U.S. based position is the ability to work legally in the United States. No visa sponsorship/support is available for this position, including for any type of U.S. permanent residency (green card) process. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing operational KPIs, performance scorecards, executive dashboards, and value-realization reporting. Demonstrated experience developing and implementing project management, change management, and process improvement methodologies. Experience facilitating governance forums, leadership reviews, workshops, and structured problem-solving sessions. Experience implementing or supporting technology-enabled solutions, automation initiatives, workflow improvements, or digital transformation efforts. Experience with process mining, automation, AI-enabled solutions, workflow technologies, or service management platforms. Experience leading cross-functional teams and coordinating resources across multiple workstreams and initiatives. Significant experience leading continuous improvement, operational excellence, transformation, program management, or service delivery initiatives. Experience leading a Citizen Developer program and governing low-code/no-code solutions such as Microsoft Power Platform. Experience in HR Service Delivery, Shared Services, Global Business Services (GBS), or customer support environments. Certification in Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, Scrum, Project Management (PMP), Prosci Change Management, or comparable methodologies. 
 
 Skills

Influential Leadership: Proven ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment across diverse teams without direct authority. Communication: Excellent communication, facilitation, consulting, and stakeholder management skills. Strategic Mindset: The ability to develop and execute a long-term HR continuous improvement strategy by aligning process enhancement initiatives with business objectives, workforce priorities, and organizational transformation goals. Process Improvement: The ability to identify, analyze, and optimize HR processes through data-driven decision making and cross-functional collaboration to enhance efficiency, employee experience, compliance, and service delivery outcomes.
