title: Manager HR
description:
Job Description Manager, Human Resources (Caf Operations) 
 Function: Human Resources
 Designation: Manager HR
 Location: New Delhi
 Role Overview The Manager – HR will be responsible for managing end-to-end HR operations for the caf business, with a primary focus on frontline recruitment, employee lifecycle management, HR documentation, attendance and employee relations. The role involves regular caf visits, close coordination with Operations teams and ensuring consistent implementation of HR policies, processes and statutory requirements across assigned locations. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Frontline Recruitment & Manpower Planning Manage end-to-end recruitment for caf frontline positions, including Team Members, Shift Managers, Caf Managers and other operational roles. Coordinate with Operations and Area Managers to understand manpower requirements and ensure timely closures. Drive local sourcing through walk-ins, referrals, job portals and other relevant channels. Track vacancies, joining ratios, hiring TAT and manpower availability across assigned cafs. 2. Employee Documentation & Onboarding Coordinate joining formalities and ensure timely completion of employee documentation and verification. Ensure appointment letters, employee records and other statutory documents are completed and maintained. Coordinate with Payroll and HR teams for employee code generation and onboarding-related requirements. Ensure adherence to defined joining processes and documentation standards. 3. Caf Visits & HR Operations Conduct regular caf visits to interact with employees and Operations teams and understand ground-level HR concerns. Review employee documentation, attendance, manpower deployment and compliance-related records. Identify process gaps and ensure timely corrective action in coordination with the respective stakeholders. Support the implementation of HR policies, processes and initiatives across cafs. 4. Attendance, Exits & Employee Lifecycle Management Monitor attendance, absenteeism, irregularities and employee availability across assigned locations. Coordinate with Operations and Payroll for attendance regularisation and timely resolution of discrepancies. Track employee exits, resignations, absconding cases, full and final settlements and exit documentation. Maintain accurate employee movement and separation records. 5. Employee Relations & Grievance Management Address frontline employee grievances and coordinate with Operations for timely resolution. Participate in disciplinary meetings, conduct employee discussions and coordinate issuance of warning letters, show-cause notices and other disciplinary communications. Support investigations and documentation of employee-related cases in consultation with the HR leadership. Ensure consistent and fair application of disciplinary processes. 6. Statutory Compliance & HR Governance Coordinate local compliance checks at cafs and ensure availability of required employee and statutory records. Support internal and external HR audits and facilitate closure of identified gaps. Ensure adherence to company policies, HR SOPs and applicable labour regulations. Maintain trackers and reports on compliance, documentation and employee-related matters. 7. Stakeholder Coordination & HR Reporting Work closely with Regional Operations, Area Managers and Caf Managers on all people-related matters. Act as the primary HR point of contact for assigned locations. Prepare periodic reports on hiring, manpower gaps, attendance, attrition, exits and employee concerns. Drive HR initiatives and ensure timely communication and implementation at the caf level. 
 Desired Candidate Profile Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR preferred. 5–8 years of HR experience, preferably in Retail, QSR, FMCG, Hospitality or other multi-location businesses. Strong experience in frontline/high-volume recruitment and HR operations. Good understanding of employee documentation, attendance, payroll coordination and labour compliance. Experience handling employee grievances and disciplinary matters. Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills. Willingness to travel extensively and conduct regular caf visits. Good communication, interpersonal and problem-solving skills. Proficiency in MS Excel and HRMS platforms.

title: Human Resource Manager
description:
Indus Parking Services (IPS) is an emerging parking enforcement company headquartered in Gurugram, India. Our team consists of highly focused and motivated professionals with extensive expertise in parking management. We specialise in preventing unauthorised parking across commercial properties, residential complexes, and other locations. Indus Parking Services manages the entire parking enforcement process efficiently and also provides operational support to Euro Parking Services.
 We are looking for an experienced HR Manager to join us, who plays a crucial role in leading the human resources function and supporting the overall growth of the organization. This position involves developing and implementing HR policies, managing recruitment and employee relations, and ensuring smooth coordination of HR and administrative activities across the company. The HR Manager contributes to building a positive workplace culture and upholding compliance with employment regulations and policies. 
 As an HR Manager , your responsibilities will include: Partnering with leadership to develop and implement HR strategies, policies, and procedures aligned with the company's overall business goals and objectives. Managing the end-to-end recruitment and selection process, including sourcing, job postings, screening resumes, conducting interviews, and extending job offers. Coordinating with new employees, onboarding and orientation programs to ensure a smooth transition into the organization. Administering and overseeing competitive employee benefits and compensation programs, including leave policies. Overseeing performance management processes, including employee evaluations, feedback sessions, and performance improvement plans. Handling employee relation issues, including conflict resolution, disciplinary actions, and grievances, while nurturing a positive and productive workplace culture. Ensuring compliance with all relevant labor laws, regulations, and employment standards, including statutory filings and audits. Maintaining accurate employee records, including attendance and leave records, and HR databases/HRMS. Overseeing payroll processing and ensuring timely and accurate disbursement of salaries and wages. Providing HR support and guidance to managers and employees, using relevant HR metrics and reporting to inform decisions. Assessing training needs and coordinating learning and development programs to enhance employee skills and competencies. Overseeing office administration tasks, including facilities management, stakeholder coordination, and office supplies procurement. Monitoring and managing HR and office budgets, expenses, and cost-saving initiatives. Ensuring a safe and healthy work environment by implementing and enforcing safety policies and procedures. Building and managing effective interpersonal relationships at all levels of the organization to support business objectives. Staying updated on HR trends, employment legislation, and best practices to drive continuous improvement in HR and administrative processes. 
 The ideal candidate working as an HR Manager will display: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, or a related field. A Masters degree or HR certification is preferred. Proven work experience as an HR Manager, Senior HR Generalist, or similar role, with at least 7-10 years of overall HR experience, including a minimum of 2 years in a supervisory or leadership capacity. Strong functional HR expertise across the areas outlined above. Demonstrable experience using HR metrics and reporting to support management decision-making. Strong understanding of labor laws, employment legislation, and compliance requirements. Excellent communication, active listening, negotiation, and presentation skills. Strong leadership and people management skills, with a proven ability to build, guide, and develop high-performing teams. Ability to work independently, help architect HR strategy, and manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Proficiency in HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) and MS Office applications. Attention to detail and accuracy in data management and record-keeping. Problem-solving and decision-making abilities with a proactive and solutions-oriented approach. Strong organizational and time management skills. 
 Benefits of working with IPA Indus Parking Services Limited as an HR Manager: Employee of the month programme Regular performance review to encourage internal growth 
 Timings: 11 am to 8 pm (Monday- Friday)

title: Lead IT Recruiter (Domestic IT)
description:
Job Title: Lead IT Recruiter (Domestic IT) Experience: 10+ Years 
 Recruitment Type: Domestic IT (India-based hiring) 
 Employment Type: Full-time 
 Job Summary 
 We are looking for an experienced Lead IT Recruiter with strong expertise in Domestic IT recruitment to lead end-to-end hiring activities, mentor recruitment teams, and drive strategic talent acquisition initiatives. The ideal candidate should have deep knowledge of IT technologies, strong stakeholder management skills, and proven leadership capabilities. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Lead and manage end-to-end IT recruitment for domestic clients/projects. Handle senior and niche IT requirements across technologies (Java, .NET, Cloud, DevOps, Data, SAP, etc.). Collaborate with business leaders, delivery managers, and HR stakeholders to understand workforce needs. Design and execute effective sourcing strategies using job portals, referrals, social media, and networking. Mentor, guide, and review performance of junior recruiters and recruitment teams. Ensure adherence to hiring SLAs, TATs, and quality benchmarks . Conduct candidate screening, interviews, offer negotiations, and closures. Maintain recruitment metrics, dashboards, and reporting for leadership review. Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for current and future needs. Ensure compliance with company hiring policies and best practices. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications 
 10+ years of experience in Domestic IT recruitment . Strong understanding of IT skills, roles, and technology trends. Proven experience in team handling and leadership . Excellent stakeholder and candidate management skills. Expertise in job portals (Naukri, indeed, etc.), LinkedIn sourcing, and ATS tools. Strong communication, negotiation, and decision-making abilities. Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience in IT services, product companies, or staffing firms. Exposure volume and lateral hiring. Knowledge of employer branding and recruitment marketing. MBA (HR). 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 Those who worked for Infosys, Tech Mahindra, TCS, Oracle, Cape Gemini...etc.

title: HR Manager
description:
Job Summary We are looking for an experienced HR Manager to manage end-to-end HR activities and support the organization s growing workforce. Responsibilities Manage end-to-end recruitment, including sourcing, screening, interviews, and onboarding. Handle HR operations including attendance, leave, employee records, and HR documentation. Manage employee onboarding, probation, confirmation, transfers, and exit formalities. Coordinate payroll inputs, salary revisions, and employee-related queries. Conduct performance reviews, appraisals, and employee evaluations. Develop and implement HR policies and processes. Handle employee grievances and maintain a positive work environment. Plan employee engagement activities and initiatives. Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and company policies. Prepare and maintain HR reports, trackers, and MIS. Work closely with management and department heads on HR requirements. Required skills 4-5 years of experience in HR. MBA/PGDM in HR, MSW, or relevant qualification. Strong experience in HR Operations and Recruitment. Good knowledge of payroll, attendance, leave, performance management, and HR policies. Strong communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and handle multiple HR activities. Hands-on sourcing through job portals and LinkedIn, with structured screening and interviewing. Working knowledge of statutory compliance, including PF, ESI, Professional Tax, and Gratuity. Experience setting KRAs/KPIs and running appraisal cycles. Experience drafting HR policies, offer letters, and other HR documents. Proficiency in MS Excel or Google Sheets for HR reports, trackers, and MIS. Discretion and confidentiality in handling employee data and grievances. Preferred skills Experience in an IT/software or startup environment. Experience with an HRMS/HRIS or attendance and payroll software. Basic knowledge of working with AI tools.
